scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate: for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do docker exec -i ffhandball-postgres psql -U ffhandball -d ffhandball < "$f"; done
scripts.db:seed: for f in db/seeds/*.sql; do docker exec -i ffhandball-postgres psql -U ffhandball -d ffhandball < "$f"; done
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it ffhandball-postgres psql -U ffhandball -d ffhandball
